rules: Every existing six-node success keeps its original backend, fit, settings and source outcomes.
A recovery candidate is eligible only if its own backend's original six-node standard fit failed a declared curve-related gate.
Select using reference calibration availability only, never source outcomes or whole-clip labels.
Keep minimum confidence, coverage, three cycles, observed paths, angle allowances, fault dwell and 80% reconstruction unchanged.
Preserve original raw MP33 world/image/confidence values, capture PTS, view, tracked contexts and provenance.
Report new acceptances from weakly labelled clips without calling them correct/incorrect human reps.
No independent final-test trajectories may be opened by this experiment.
